{{Quote|I have a bad feeling about this!|Wedge Antilles before he starts the mission|<ref name="Rogue Squadron III" />}}
During this '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Destrillion]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] was assigned to pinpoint critical targets in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] Gas facility for a squad of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] to [[Proton bomb/Legends|bomb]]. Antilles flew through the tunnels leading to the facility and engaged a new [[TIE/hu "Hunter" Multi-Role Starfighter|Imperial starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]. He subsequently took out the [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] and discovered that there was in fact no facility.

==Prelude==
[[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] received information about an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas<ref name="Rogue Squadron III" /> installation conducting scientific weapons research in the [[Destrillion]] system.<ref name="RS III guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] was given a task force, including the ace [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] to destroy the installation.<ref name="Rogue Squadron III" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|They've activated some sort of force field. I'm trapped!''"<br />"''Wedge, we can't reach you. You're on your own.|Wedge Antilles and Crix Madine|<ref name="Rogue Squadron III" />}}
[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] flew an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] and was in command of a squad of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] toward the facility. General Crix Madine contacted him and informed him of his mission objectives. Antilles noticed the energy fields protecting the facility included a series of corridors and volunteered to fly through them. In the tunnel, Antilles encountered about two squadrons of [[TIE/hu "Hunter" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Hunters]] flying around a [[Tibanna gas platform]]. Antilles later relayed the presence of the squadron to Madine, and stated that he hadn't encountered them before, with Madine then deducing that they were most likely the Empire's new Hunter line of TIE fighters: The Hunters were a new [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]]<ref name="Rogue Squadron III" /> designed to match the capabilities of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="RS III guide" /> Madine contacted Antilles and warned him of the dangers the new TIEs posed. [[Force field/Legends|Force fields]] activated, blocking the corridors. Antilles subsequently engaged the Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] and was able to destroy them with the help of his A-wing's [[Missile/Legends|missiles]]. With the TIEs gone, the force fields deactivated. Antilles then contacted Madine, who ordered the pilot to continue into the second tunnel to locate the facility.<ref name="Rogue Squadron III" />

Continuing to the end of the tunnels, Antilles discovered that there was no facility; there was just was a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of [[Imperial Action transport|transports]] about to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Antilles contacted Madine with this fact, and Madine ordered him to return to the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. In truth, the battle was a diversion in order to [[Battle of Dubrillion (Galactic Civil War)|lure]] a Rebel convoy near [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]] and destroy it using Dubrillion's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron III" /> [[File:Concept_RS3.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Rebel Strike concept art of a floating, airborne installation.]]

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Infiltrate the Empire's secret research facility. Locate vital targets, and transmit their coordinates to the Y-wing groups.|Mission briefing for "Deception at Destrillion"|<ref name="Rogue Squadron III" />}}
This event was a mission appearing in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''. In the Developer's Commentary, it was revealed there was to be an extended mission, but was cut out for time. It would have involved an infiltration of the facility via a walker, and calling Y-wings targeting sensitive areas. The player was originally tasked with destroying a floating installation. The [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] is the default craft for the mission but it is possible to fly another craft in later run-throughs.

The mission, "Deception at Destrillion," contained a tech upgrade. However, it was not within the Destrillion level itself. It was, however, in the Dubrillion half of the mission.
